title: Wings live: Hordern Pavilion, Sydney | 1975
content:
Wings performed at the Hordern Pavilion in Sydney, Australia, on 7 November 1975.

It was the 17th night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976, and the first of two consecutive nights in Sydney.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

Ringo Starr performed at the Hordern Pavilion on 13 and 14 February 2013.
